systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur (decree on its proposal)
systems.tiers: national: a twelve-position number attributed to every person entered in a civil-status register, including registers kept by diplomatic and consular missions, and to regularly resident foreigners; mandatory on acts and files of state services, regions, communes, hospitals, schools and utilities
Article 10 provides that earlier acts will be keyed in as part of implementing the NNI; the capture ends mid-article

note: A decree on the composition and scope of the identity number; the civil-status register is the basis for attribution, and nothing is said of how offices record events.
